bna_crosswalk_events.packaging: box fitted with racks, brass lock and key
bna_crosswalk_events.evidence: Direct BNA preview price for Amadio's Students' Box of Microscopic Preparations.
Students' Box of Microscopic Preparations advertised alongside catalogue and books on using the microscope.
Great Exhibition jury list identifies Bourgogne of France with microscopic preparations.
A local microscopy paper was illustrated by numerous preparations attributed to Bourgogne.
Syndicated exhibition report describes Norman showing a large series of microscopic slides with sections and preparations across many kinds of objects.
Reader advice recommends Norman for glass slides and other microscopy articles.
Wheeler is described as devoting himself to microscope manufacture and preparation of microscopic objects; hundreds of his objects were lent for display.
Announcement states that Wheeler of London would exhibit one thousand microscopic preparations, 'no two alike'.
Advertisement lists microscopes and slides, states purchases and exchanges, and offers a catalogue for three stamps.
bna_crosswalk_events.guard: This is evidence for an earlier Watson trade catalogue, but it should not be equated automatically with the 1885 dedicated slide catalogue.

bna_crosswalk_events.evidence: Microscopic slides lent by Watson & Son and C. Baker & Son for a Rochester Naturalists' Club entertainment.
The firm showed microscopes and a series of soiree slides including diatoms and butterfly scales.
Second-hand microscope advertisement sells a large slide lot by named makers; a near-duplicate 27 November advertisement also includes Wheeler.
bna_crosswalk_events.interpretive_value: Maker names remain saleable provenance/value descriptors decades after initial production.

corpus_negatives_and_guards.name: J. D. Möller
corpus_negatives_and_guards.result: No direct BNA retail hit recovered in the current BNA master under Möller/Moller variants.
corpus_negatives_and_guards.note: Core periodical corpus contains many Möller probe/type-plate references; these should be separated from commercial prepared-slide catalogue evidence.

corpus_negatives_and_guards.name: W. Watson & Sons
corpus_negatives_and_guards.result: BNA contains Watson trade and exhibition material, but not every Watson occurrence belongs to the firm.

research_payoff.first_order_claim: Commercial slide catalogues should be treated as one state in a longer transaction history, not as static inventories. The same makers and preparations move through priced retail, boxed pedagogy, exhibitions, society lending, exchange and second-hand resale.
research_payoff.strongest_current_case: Amadio already supplies quantity, packaging, intended user and price in newspaper advertising; Norman, Bourgogne, Wheeler and Watson show complementary circulation modes that can be cross-read against their catalogues.
